query:
UPDATE house_races SET
  candidate1_bio = 'Marcy Kaptur is a Democrat who has represented Ohio''s 9th Congressional District since 1983, making her the longest-serving woman in U.S. congressional history. She is a senior member of the House Appropriations Committee and a strong advocate for manufacturing workers in the Great Lakes region. Kaptur survived a tough 2022 redistricting race and has won re-election consistently in a district that has trended more competitive.',
  candidate2_bio = 'Derek Merrin is a Republican who served in the Ohio House of Representatives from 2015 to 2023, including as Speaker Pro Tempore. He ran against Marcy Kaptur in 2022 and lost by fewer than 5,000 votes in one of the closest House races of that cycle. Merrin is a small business owner and farmer from Fulton County who has focused his campaign on economic issues and border security.'
WHERE id = 307;

UPDATE house_races SET
  candidate1_bio = 'Vicente Gonzalez Jr. is a Democrat who has represented South Texas in Congress since 2017, first in TX-15 and then in TX-34 after the 2022 redistricting. He is a businessman and attorney who has focused on border security, trade, and economic development for the Rio Grande Valley. Gonzalez won TX-34 in 2022 by just 1.3 points in one of the most competitive House races of that cycle.',
  candidate2_bio = 'Eric Flores is a Republican businessman and community leader from the Rio Grande Valley who is challenging incumbent Democrat Vicente Gonzalez Jr. in Texas''s 34th Congressional District. He has emphasized border security, economic development, and energy policy. Flores is part of a broader Republican effort to expand their gains in heavily Hispanic South Texas.'
WHERE id = 394;

UPDATE house_races SET
  candidate1_bio = 'Denise Powell is a Nebraska Democrat and community organizer from Omaha who is running in the open seat race for Nebraska''s 2nd Congressional District. She has focused her campaign on healthcare access, economic opportunity, and protecting Social Security and Medicare. NE-2 is one of the few congressional districts that awards its electoral vote separately from the state, and it voted for Biden in 2020 and Harris in 2024.',
  candidate2_bio = 'Brinker Harding is a Nebraska Republican attorney and businessman from Omaha who is running for the open seat in Nebraska''s 2nd Congressional District. He has emphasized fiscal conservatism, support for small businesses, and a tough stance on immigration. Harding is competing in a district that has trended toward Democrats in recent presidential elections despite Nebraska''s overall Republican lean.'
WHERE id = 235;

UPDATE house_races SET
  candidate1_bio = 'Henry Cuellar is a Democrat who has represented South Texas in Congress since 2005 and is one of the most conservative Democrats in the House. He has frequently broken with his party on immigration, energy, and gun issues, and has maintained strong support in his heavily Hispanic district. Cuellar was indicted on federal bribery charges in May 2024 but won re-election; he has pleaded not guilty and his trial is pending.',
  candidate2_bio = 'Tano Tijerina is a Republican and the Webb County Judge (the county''s chief executive) who has served in that role since 2015. He is a longtime Democrat who switched to the Republican Party in 2024, citing concerns about border security and the direction of the national Democratic Party. Tijerina is part of a wave of South Texas Latino officials who have shifted to the GOP in recent election cycles.'
WHERE id = 388;

UPDATE house_races SET
  candidate1_bio = 'Donald Davis is a Democrat who has represented North Carolina''s 1st Congressional District since 2023. He is a U.S. Air Force veteran and former Pitt County Commissioner who won the seat in 2022. Davis serves on the House Agriculture Committee and Armed Services Committee and has focused on rural economic development and veterans'' issues.',
  candidate2_bio = 'Laurie Buckhout is a Republican and retired U.S. Army Colonel who served 28 years in the military, including as the first female commander of the Army''s Electronic Warfare unit. She ran against Donald Davis in 2024 and lost by about 3 points. Buckhout has focused her campaign on border security, veterans'' issues, and the need for military experience in Congress.'
WHERE id = 284;
